about_the_game:
Legend Of The Platforms is a multi platform original board game. Bribe the Earth enemy with Earth currency and the underworld guard with heaven currency. Venture into the underworld to rescue a man's wife who knew all the secrets of existence and bring her back to Earth. Find a rare gem in the underworld to bring to a blacksmith on Earth in order to forge a blade to kill any enemy. Go to the heavens and collect heaven currency to bribe the underworld guard or pay the blacksmith to forge a blade. The guardian angels in heaven will train you to be the most powerful on the board when the blade forged by underworld gems is brought to them. Careful, if the underworld guard sees that you freed the man's wife, he will look for you on Earth and in the underworld. Don't let the heaven guard catch you, for the next time you enter heaven, you may fall to your death due to his lack of forgiveness.

Each platform in the game acts as a different dimension with different sets of rules. The game features a day and night cycle as well as a visual of playing the boardgame on top of a table in a cafe setting. Legend Of The Platforms is a casual game that you can play in one sitting.

Special thanks to Steven Seleb for permission to use his tunes for the soundtrack.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes a rare gem in the underworld that can kill any of the supernatural enemies in the game, which can be considered drug related content. Running into the heaven guard to where you fall back to Earth, and falling to your death after entering heaven again after drawing cards that make you fall due to the Heaven guards lack of forgiveness could be viewed as accidental death.

short_description: From the creator of "Diamond Board" gives you "Legend Of The Platforms". There is Heaven or Earth currency to collect, a rare gem in the underworld to bring to a blacksmith to forge a blade, a man's wife to rescue from the underworld, and guardian angels who will train you to be the most powerful.
